# dsh-material-library
A material library for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): collect what a conversation produced — a folder, a
file, a note — keep it in real folders with tags, and jump back to the chat it came from in one clic
le, a note — keep it in real folders with tags, and jump back to the chat it came from in one click.
中文说明
## What it does
- **Collect from a conversation.** A button in the session header and a `从对话采集 / Collect from chat`
button in the library open a picker: choose a conversation, browse its working directory, pick a fol
der or a file, name the entry, choose the library folder and tags. Entries point at the original pat

h; nothing is copied.
- **Real folders, real files.** A note is a `.md` file on disk; the folder tre
e *is* the directory tree under the library root (default `~/.dsh/materials`). Tags live in `.index.

json` beside it. You can edit either from outside the app.
- **Finder-like browsing.** Source list (
all materials / folders / tags) · list view with name, updated, folder and tags · detail pane with a

file card, a default-app button and an "open with…" menu.
- **Open with…** runs the macOS `open` co
mmand: the default app, or another installed application picked from a menu, or reveal in Finder. Im

ages preview inline; text and Markdown render in the detail pane.
- **Read like a chat.** Markdown i
s rendered with the typography of conversation messages — headings, nested lists, quotes, code block

s, tables, rules — including when the entry is a reference to a file outside the library.
- **Reopen
the source.** For a collected entry, `Open in original session` switches to that conversation and o

pens the folder in its right sidebar.
- **Everything is editable.** Rename or delete a folder or tag
from the sidebar (a tag rename rewrites it everywhere; a folder rename moves its files), edit name/

folder/tags of any entry, search names, bodies and tags.
- **Version history.** Every save keeps the
previous body under `.history/` (up to 30 per file). Open `Versions` in the detail header, read any
version in the pane, and restore it — restoring snapshots the current body first, so a restore is u

ndoable. Notes kept: refs and folders have no versions.
- **Copy a reference into the library.** A c
ollected entry can be turned into a real file inside the library (`收进库 / Copy into library`); the or

iginal is untouched.

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Published on npm as `dsh-material-library`; installing straight from GitHub also works: `dsh plugin
--profile <your-profile> add github:yingqi-studio/dsh-material-library`.
In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins**, search the name, and install it there. Restart `dsh web` (or refre
sh the page) and the library appears as an icon in the sidebar.
Requires a host with the sidebar-entry and right-sidebar slots (`dsh.web` 0.2.x). `engines.dsh` is d
eclared as `>=0.2.0`.
## Where things are stored
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Set `root` in the plugin config to move the library elsewhere. Writes are serialized and atomic (`.t
mp` + rename); paths are confined to the library root, and collected targets must stay inside your h
paths are confined to the library root, and collected targets must stay inside your home directory.
## HTTP API
The UI talks to the host over same-origin JSON routes under `/api/dsh-materials` (no generated remot
es, so it stays dependency-free):
| Method | Route | Purpose |

| GET | `/health` | library root, readiness |
| GET | `/home` | home directory (fallback start for t

he picker) |
| GET | `/state` | folders, notes, references, tag counts |
| GET | `/list?path=` | lis

t a directory outside the library (for the picker) |
| GET | `/file?path=` | read a note |
| GET | `

/ref/preview?id=` | read a referenced text file for the detail pane |
| GET | `/ref/raw?id=` | raw b

ytes of a referenced file (images) |
| GET | `/openers?path=` | installed apps that can open a targe

t, with icons |
| GET | `/search?q=&tag=` | search names, bodies and tags |
| GET | `/session-times`

| last-modified time per session (picker ordering) |
| POST | `/create` `/update` `/delete` | notes

|
| POST | `/folder` `/folder/rename` `/folder/delete` | folders |
| POST | `/tag/rename` `/tag/del

ete` | tags |
| POST | `/ref/add` `/ref/update` `/ref/delete` | collected references |
| POST | `/op

en` | open / reveal a target with the OS |
| GET | `/versions?path=` | saved versions of a note (id,

time, size) |
| GET | `/version?path=&id=` | read one saved version |
| POST | `/restore` | restore

a version (snapshots the current body first) |
| POST | `/ref/copy` | copy a collected reference in

to the library as a real file |
| POST | `/import` | copy a file or directory from inside the home d

irectory into the library |
| POST | `/archive` | file files or a folder into the library as referen

ces (idempotent; merges tags on a path already filed) |
| GET | `/rules` | auto-filing rules (root,

folder, tags, last run) |
| POST | `/rules/run` | run the rules of one session now |
| POST | `/rule
s/delete` | forget one rule |
Everything that mutates goes through one serialized store; conflicts (duplicate name, non-empty fold
er, unknown application) come back as readable 4xx errors.
## Agent tool: materials_archive
A scheduled task can file its own output. The host registers one tool, `materials_archive`, availabl
n file its own output. The host registers one tool, `materials_archive`, available in every session:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `path` — file or folder (supports `~`; a relative path resolves against the session's working dire

ctory). Omitted: the working directory.
- `folder` — library folder; empty/omitted files at the root

. Created on demand.
- `tags` — merged with whatever the entry already carries.
- `depth` — `1` (def
ault) files the files directly inside a folder, `0` files the folder itself as one entry, up to `12`

.
- `include` — comma separated suffix/glob filter, e.g. `.html,.jpg` or `*.png`.
- `limit` — stop a
fter N entries (default 50, max 200).
